course.title: Accounting and Auditing for Planners
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: Shasti opened her own consulting firm, Shasti Consulting on May 1, 2016. The following transactions occurred during the month of May
May-1 Shasti invested TK 1,80,000 cash to start the firm.
May-2 Paid cash TK 18,000 for office rent for the month.
May-3Purchased office supplies on account TK 15,000.
May-4 Paid TK 1,500 to advertise in the “ Daily Bangladesh Protidin”
May-7 Received TK 45,000 cash for services provided.
May-10Withdrew TK 10,000 cash for personal use.
May-12 Performed TK 40,000 of service on account.
May-15Paid cash TK 30,000 for employee salaries.
May-18 Paid for supplies purchased on account on May 3.
May-20 Received TK 30,000 cash for services provided on account on May 12.
May-22 Borrowed TK 50,000 cash from the Bank on a note payable.
May-25 Purchased office furniture for TK 24,000 on account.
May-30 Utility bill paid in cash TK 2,000.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2017
